name: OnFRA — Onfra Financial Intelligence Agent
description: MCP discovery for OnFRA (OnChain Financial Reputation Agent) on Onfra. Analyzes Celo wallet activity — transaction history, cash flow, wallet age, and asset composition — to produce financial health scores, reputation ratings, income stability, portfolio risk, loan capacity, and Verified Financial Reputation Reports. Query any wallet address or use the Onfra dashboard at https://wallet-profile-orpin.vercel.app.

tools.name: analyze_wallet
tools.description: Analyze any Celo wallet address. Returns Financial Health Score, Wallet Reputation Score, Income Stability classification, Portfolio Risk Exposure, loan capacity, and AI financial summary. Own wallet is free; external queries cost 0.01 USDT via x402.

months.description: Months of transaction history for cash-flow statement.

fields.description: Optional subset of fields instead of full walletData.

tools.name: get_wallet_signal
tools.description: Read one reputation signal from cached analysis (free). Signal ids: monthly-income, financial-health, reputation-score, loan-capacity, statement, assessment. Returns 404 with hint to analyze_wallet if cache is missing.

tools.name: chat_query
tools.description: Natural-language query about any wallet's financial health, reputation, income stability, portfolio risk, or loan capacity. Own wallet is free; external queries cost 0.01 USDT via x402 when enforcement is enabled.

message.description: Question about a wallet's financial reputation.

walletAddress.description: Target wallet. Required for external wallet queries.

tools.name: screen_wallet
tools.description: Lender underwriting screen for a borrower wallet. Returns trustworthiness (trust.isTrustworthy), wallet reputation, average monthly income estimate, and loan capacity range (with confidence). Requires callerAddress (lender wallet) and x402 payment of 0.01 USDT.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Purchase a Verified Financial Reputation Report with transaction statements, scores, AI summary, and verification code. Costs 0.10 USDT via x402.

tools.name: verify_report
tools.description: Confirm a Verified Financial Reputation Report verification code (WP-...) or report ID (REP-...) was issued by OnFRA on Onfra.

prompts.name: financial_health

prompts.name: reputation_check
prompts.description: What is this wallet's reputation and trust rating?

prompts.name: income_stability
prompts.description: Is this wallet a stable earner? What is the income classification?

prompts.name: portfolio_risk
prompts.description: What is the portfolio risk exposure for this wallet?

prompts.name: loan_capacity
prompts.description: How much can this wallet safely borrow?

prompts.name: verified_report
prompts.description: Generate a Verified Financial Reputation Report for lending.

integration.note: OnFRA lender infrastructure: https://wallet-profile-orpin.vercel.app/developers · Lender screen: 0.01 USDT · Full analyze: 0.01 USDT · Verified report: 0.10 USDT · REST: screen_wallet → POST /api/lender/screen · analyze_wallet → POST /api/agent/analyze · get_wallet_signal → GET /api/wallet/{address}/signals/{signal} · chat_query → POST /api/agent/chat · generate_report → POST /api/agent/report · verify_report → GET /api/agent/verify/{reportId}
